questions.question: If the number 476**0 is divisible by both 3 and 11, then in the hundredth and tenth places, the non-zero digits are, respectively:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For divisibility by **3**, the sum of digits (4 + 7 + 6 + x + y + 0 = 17 + x + y) must be a multiple of 3.

For divisibility by **11**, the difference of sums of alternate digits (x + 7 + 0) − (y + 6 + 4) = x − y − 3 must be 0 or a multiple of 11.

Testing Option (4) where **x = 8** and **y = 5**:

Sum = 17 + 8 + 5 = 30, which is divisible by 3. Difference = 8 − 5 − 3 = 0, which is divisible by 11.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 and 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Number is 476xy0, where x is at the **hundredth** place and y is at the **tenth** place.

**Divisibility by 3:** Sum of digits = 4 + 7 + 6 + x + y + 0 = 17 + x + y.

**Divisibility by 11:** (Sum of digits at odd places) − (Sum of digits at even places) = 0 or 11n.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6d76cc3b87dbdf6bc9af1a1e01055baa8452dc4d0e0b1475f6486ab095891f5.png] 

⇒ Sum of odd positions (from right) = 0 + x + 7 = 7 + x

⇒ Sum of even positions (from right) = y + 6 + 4 = 10 + y

⇒ Difference = (10 + y) − (7 + x) = y − x + 3

⇒ For divisibility by 11: y − x + 3 = 0 or 11

⇒ Case 1: x − y = 3

⇒ From options, if x = 8 and y = 5, then 8 − 5 = 3 (Satisfied)

⇒ Sum of digits check: 17 + 8 + 5 = 30 (Multiple of 3, Satisfied)

**∴ The correct answer is 8 and 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the **absolute difference** between the sum of digits at odd places and even places is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Combined Divisibility

If a number is divisible by both 3 and 11, it is also divisible by **33** (since 3 and 11 are co-primes).</p

questions.question: A cylinder of height 8 cm and radius 6 cm is melted and converted into 3 cones of the same radius and height that of cylinder. Determine the curved surface area of cones.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cone** with **radius (r)** = 6 cm and **height (h)** = 8 cm, the **slant height (l)** is a Pythagorean triplet (6, 8, 10), so l = 10 cm.

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of one cone = πrl = π × 6 × 10 = 60π cm².

Total **CSA** of 3 such cones = 3 × 60π = 180π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 180π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Radius (r)** = 6 cm, **Height (h)** = 8 cm, **Number of cones** = 3.

**Formula:** Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²); Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb59fc9b5ad3ad84f20b6abb44f5487cda41dfb74ba7cb8c519ab293b954407c.png] 

⇒ Slant height (l) of each cone = √(6² + 8²)

⇒ l = √(36 + 64) = √100 = 10 cm

⇒ CSA of one cone = π × 6 × 10 = 60π cm²

⇒ Total CSA of 3 cones = 3 × 60π = 180π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 180π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume Relation

The volume of a **cylinder** (πr²h) is exactly 3 times the volume of a **cone** (1/3 πr²h) with the same radius and height.

Total Surface Area of Cone

TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r). It includes the **curved area** and the **circular base**.

Slant Height Property

In a **right circular cone**, the height, radius, and slant height always form a **right-angled triangle** following l² = r² + h².</p

questions.question: The heights of two right circular cones are in the ratio 1 ∶ 5 and the perimeter of their bases are in the ratio 5 ∶ 3. Find the ratio of their volumes.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The heights of the two right circular cones are in the ratio 1 : 5 

Ratio of the perimeter of their bases 5 : 3 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of right circular cone = (1)/(3)πr²h 

Perimeter of the base of cone = 2πr 

Where, r = radius of the cone

h= height of the cone 

**Calculation:**

Here, let us take the height of the two circular cones h₁ and h₂ respectively

Also, their perimeter of bases be p₁ and p₂ respectively 

Now, we have (h₁)/(h₂) = (1)/(5) and (p₁)/(p₂) = (5)/(3) 

⇒ 2πr₁ : 2πr₂ = 5 : 3 

⇒ (r₁)/(r₂) = (5)/(3 )

Now, ratio of volume of the cones 

⇒ (1)/(3)πr₁²h₁ : (1)/(3)r₂² h₂ 

⇒ r₁² h₁ : r₂² h₂ ⇔ (r₁²)/(r₂²) : (h₂ )/(h₁)

⇒ (5²)/(3²) : (5)/(1) ⇔ (25)/(9) : 5 

⇒ 5 : 9 

**Hence, the ratio of volume of the cones is 5 : 9.**

questions.question: Find the difference between the compound interest and simple interest when a sum of Rs.15,625 is invested for 3 years at 4% per annum.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of Rs.15,625 is invested for 3 years at 4% per annum

**Formula Used:**

S.I. = (( P × R × T))/(100) 

A = P × (1 + (R)/(100))t 

A = P + C.I. 

Where, S.I. = Simple Interest, P = Principal , T = Time in years

R = Rate of interest, A = Amount 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have Principal = Rs.15625, t = 3 years, r = 4%

S.I. = ((15625 × 3 × 4))/(100) = Rs.1875 

Now, we have

A = P × (1 + (R)/(100))t

⇒ A = 15625 × (1 + (4)/(100))³ = 15625 × (26)/(25) × (26)/(25) × (26)/(25) 

⇒ A = Rs.17576 

Now, C.I. = A - P 

⇒ C.I. = 17576 - 15625 = Rs.1951 

Now, difference between compound interest and simple interest = Rs(1951 - 1875) = Rs.76 

**Hence, the required difference is Rs.76.**

questions.question: How much percentage should a racer increase speed to reduce the time by 20% to cover a fixed distance?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Time reduces to 20% to cover a fixed distance 

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, according to the given question distance is fixed 

Now, let us assume the required time be t 

So, the reduces by 20% = t × 80/100 = 4t/5 

Distance = Speed × Time 

Original speed × t = New speed × 4t/5 [As, distance is equal]

Original speed /New speed = 4t/5 ×1/t 

Original speed /New speed = 4/5 

Percentage increase in speed = 1/4 × 100 = 25% 

**Hence, the percentage increase in speed is 25%.**

( 1 + cot²theta) ( 1 - costheta ) ( 1 + costheta)

cosec²theta - cot²theta = 1

cosec²theta = 1/sin²theta

( a - b) ( a + b) = a² - b²

Where , a and b are 1st and 2nd term respectively 

**CALCULATION:**

Two circles of radii 8cm and 3 cm respectively 

Distance between them is 13 cm

Length of the direct common tangent = sqrt {d² - ( r1 - r2)²}

Where, d= distance between the circles 

r₁ and r₂ are the radii of the two circles respectively

**CALCULATION:**

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere increases by 10%, what would be the change in the surface area of the sphere?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Radius of a sphere increases by 10%

**FORMULA USED:**

Surface area of a sphere = 4 pi r²

Where, r = radius of the sphere 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the original radius be r 

Now, after increment of 10%, new radius becomes = r × 110/100 = 11r/10

Now, as we know that 

Original surface area = 4 pi r²

New surface area after increment of radius = 4 pi (11r/10)² = 4pi ×121r² /100 

Difference in surface area = 4pi [121r²/100 - r²] ⇔ 4pi ×21r² /100

Percentage increase = 4 pi×21r²/100over4pi r² × 100 ⇔ 21%

**Hence, the percentage increase in surface area is 21% .**

In the given figure, MNP, SQP, NQR and MSR are straight lines. ∠NPQ = 54° and ∠QRS = 68°. What is the degree measure of ∠SMN?

questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

∠NPQ = 54 , ∠QRS = 68

**FORMULA USED:**

Sum of the angles in a triangle is 180^circ 

 Sum of the opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180^circ

**CALCULATION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3003deb3c643b26101bffa37618bedcc66675c865eda83711943c80436b8e566.png] 

 

Here, consider a triangle RMN in which ∠MRN = 68

Now, as we know that sum of the angles in a triangle is 180

⇒ ∠RMN + ∠RNM + ∠MRN = 180

⇒∠ RMN + ∠RNM + 68 = 180 

⇒ ∠RMN + ∠RNM = 112 ............( 1)

Now, consider another triangle which is PSM , in which∠SPM = 54

⇒ ∠PSM + ∠PMS + ∠SPM = 180 

⇒ ∠ PSM + ∠PMS = 180 - 54 

⇒ ∠PSM + ∠PMS = 126 ...............(2)

Now, from the figure we can see that ∠RMN =∠ PMS 

On subtracting eq(1) from eq(2), we get 

⇒ ∠PSM - ∠RNM = 14 ....................(3)

As, from the figure it is clearly seen that SQNM is a cyclic quadrilateral

Also, ∠QNM = ∠RNM , ∠QSM = ∠PSM [from figure it is clearly seen]

And, ∠RNM + ∠PSM = 180 .................(4) [ sum of the opposite angles in a quadrilateral = 180 ]

Now, add eq(3 ) + eq (4) 

⇒ ∠PSM = (194)/(2) = 97 

Now, put the value of ∠PSM in eq (2) ,we get

⇒ ∠PSM +∠ PMS = 126 

⇒ 97 + ∠PMS = 126

⇒ ∠PMS = 29

So, the ∠PMS = ∠ SMN = 29^circ

**Hence, ∠****SMN is 29 degree.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

**Concept Used:**

Sum of all three angles of a triangle is 180° 

Sum of opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral is 180°** **

Sum of linear pair angles is 180° 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/876ab6040a33ca5d0be8a96c7b31231f054d6e384fdf5d239ca6c48841cb92e4.png] 

**Calculation:**

In Δ RMN, 

⇒ θ + α + 68° = 180°

⇒ θ + α = 180° - 68° = 112°

⇒ θ + α = 112°

In Δ PMS,

⇒ θ + 180° - α + 54° = 180°

⇒ θ + 54° = α 

Putting this value in above equation, we get, 

⇒ θ + θ + 54° = 112°

⇒ 2θ = 112° - 54° = 58°

⇒ θ = (58)/(2) = 29° 

**∴ ** **∠**SMN is 29 degrees.

questions.question: A and B run a 12 km race on a circular track of length 1200 m. They complete one round in 300 seconds and 400 seconds, respectively. After how much time from start will the faster person meet the slower person for the last time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B run a 12 km race 

Length of circular track = 1200 m

Time taken by A to complete the first round = 300 seconds

Time taken by B to complete the first round = 400 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calculation:**

Here,

We have 12 km i.e. 12000 m race in a circular track of the length of 1200 m.

Number of round to complete the race = 12000/1200 = 10 rounds

Now,

Time taken by A to complete the first round = 300 seconds

For 10 rounds it will take 300 × 10 = 3000 seconds 

Now,

When A and B both start running,

First meet will take place in L.C.M (300,400) seconds = 1200 sec

Next meet will take place = 1200 × 2 = 2400 seconds

For next meet,

Time would be 3600 seconds, which is Not possible as A completes the race in 3000 seconds

But, to complete 10 rounds A takes 3000 seconds. So, time cannot be more than 3000 seconds

So, faster person will meet the slower person last time at 2400 seconds

**Hence, A will meet B last time at 2400 seconds**.

questions.question: The perimeters of two similar triangles are 36 cm and 24 cm, respectively. Find the ratio of their areas.
questions.solution:

The perimeters of two similar triangles are 36 cm and 24 cm respectively

If we have two similar triangles, say ABC and DEF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88d4789b666612469f93c1fe336d8229eb60e19b221c5e8d3a698d12e35161b3.png] 

Ar(triangle ABC)/Ar(triangleDEF) = (Perimeter of triangle ABC/Perimeter of triangle DEF)²

**CALCULATION:**

Here, the perimeters of two similar triangles are 36 cm and 24 cm respectively

Let us say Area of the first and second similar triangles be A₁ and A₂ respectively 

And their perimeters be P₁ and P₂ respectively 

As we know that 

⇒ (Area)₁/(Area)₂ = [(Perimeter)₁/(Perimeter₂)]²

⇒ (Area)₁/(Area)₂ = (36/24)² = 1296/576 = 9/4

⇒ (Area)₁ : (Area)₂ = 9 : 4 

**Hence, the ratio of their areas is 9 : 4.**

questions.question: Satish bought 35 notebooks for Rs. 700 and sold 28 of them for Rs. 600. Find his percentage gain.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

CP of 1 notebook = 700 ÷ 35 = ₹20

SP of 1 notebook = 600 ÷ 28 = ₹150/7

Ratio CP : SP = 20 : 150/7 = 140 : 150 = 14 : 15

Gain % = [(15 − 14) ÷ 14] × 100 = 100/14 = 50/7%

50/7% = 7 1/7%

**∴ The correct answer is 7 1/7%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total notebooks bought = 35

Cost Price (CP) for 35 notebooks = ₹700

Selling Price (SP) for 28 notebooks = ₹600

**Formula Used:**

Gain % = (Gain ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830af17c2054e60ca84987afc55e9235e37207eed82932624acbd268a74461cd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP of 1 notebook = 700 ÷ 35 = ₹20

⇒ SP of 1 notebook = 600 ÷ 28 = ₹150/7

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 150/7 − 20

⇒ Profit = (150 − 140) ÷ 7 = ₹10/7

⇒ Gain % = [(10/7) ÷ 20] × 100

⇒ Gain % = (10 ÷ 140) × 100

⇒ Gain % = 100/14 = 50/7%

⇒ Gain % = 7 1/7%

**∴ The correct answer is 7 1/7%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Fundamentals

Profit occurs when SP > CP. Gain = SP − CP. Loss occurs when CP > SP. Loss = CP − SP.

Percentage Calculations

Gain% = (Gain/CP) × 100. Loss% = (Loss/CP) × 100. Both are always calculated on the Cost Price (CP).

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). SP = MP − Discount.

questions.question: What is the greatest number of six digits, which when divided by each of 16, 24, 72 and 84, leaves the remainder 15?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

When greatest 6 -digit number is divided by 16, 24, 72 and 84 leaves 15 as the remainder 

**CALCULATION:**

As, we know that the greatest number of 6- digit is 999999

Now, find the L.C.M of 16,24,72 and 84 

L.C.M ( 16,24,72 ,84) = 1008

Thus, on dividing 999999/1008 = 63 (remainder) 

Now, 999999 - 63 = 999936 

This number 999936 is completely divisible by 16,24,72 and 84 

But according to the given question, 15 is the remainder on dividing by them

So, required number = 999936 + 15 = 999951 

**Hence, the greatest number which on divided by 16, 24, 72 and 84 leaves remainder 15 is 999951 .**

questions.question: A retailer wants to sell an item for Rs. 2,700 after granting a 10% discount. What is the marked price of the item?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

A 10% **discount** means the item is sold at 90% of its **Marked Price**.

90% of Marked Price = ₹2,700

1% of Marked Price = 2,700 ÷ 90 = 30

100% (Marked Price) = 30 × 100 = ₹3,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Selling Price (SP)** = ₹2,700

**Discount Percentage** = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price (MP) = [Selling Price × 100] ÷ [100 − Discount %]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca0a1d4586eb62810420f98df5c24975ad9ccda848a514ceb6ecfc2faaef1aea.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the **Marked Price** be MP.

⇒ MP = [2,700 × 100] ÷ [100 − 10]

⇒ MP = [2,700 × 100] ÷ 90

⇒ MP = 30 × 100

⇒ MP = ₹3,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP)

It is the price printed on the product label. It is the base for calculating the discount.

Selling Price (SP)

The final price paid by the customer after the discount is deducted: SP = MP − Discount.

Discount Percentage

The reduction offered on the Marked Price: Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Markup Percentage

The percentage by which the cost price is increased to set the marked price: Markup % = [(MP − CP) ÷ CP] × 100.

questions.question: Find the least value of (A + B) if the number 27B58A4 is completely divisible by 88.
questions.solution:
Given:

Number = 27B58A4

The number is divisible by 88

Concept Used:

The divisibility rule of 8 is the last 3-digit number must divisible by 8

The divisibility rule of 11 is the difference between a sum of alternative numbers that must be divisible by 11 or can be 0.

Calculations:

According to the question,

⇒ Number = 27B58A4

⇒ last 3-digit number = 8A4

⇒ when we put A = 2

⇒ then the last 3-digit becomes = 824, which is divisible by 8

⇒ and when we put A = 6

⇒ then the last 3-digit becomes = 864, which is also divisible by 8

But the least number is 2

⇒ So, The value of A = 2

⇒ Now, The number becomes = 27B5824

⇒ Sum of numbers in even place = 7 + 5 + 2 = 14

⇒ Sum of numbers in odd places = 2 + B + 8 + 4 = 14 + B

⇒ Difference = 14 + B - 14 = B

here B must be divisible by 11

⇒ so, 0 is the only number that can divisible by 11

⇒ So, the Value of B = 0

⇒ now, Value of A + B = 2 + 0 = 2

⇒ **Thus, The least value of A + B is 2.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2).**

Total work = Efficiency x Time taken

⇒ B can do the same work = 45 days

⇒ Remaining work = 180 - 18 = 162 unit work

Now, A left, and the remaining work is completed by B

⇒ Time was taken by B to complete the work = Total work / Efficiency = 162 / 4 = 40.5 days

⇒ **Hence, The work done by B after A left is 40.5 days**

questions.question: The value of {frac{{{textstyle{5 over 2}} - {textstyle{3 over 7}} times 1{textstyle{4 over 5}} div 3{textstyle{6 over 7}}}}{{{textstyle{3 over 2}} + 1{textstyle{2 over 5}} div 3{textstyle{1 over 2}} times 1{textstyle{1 over 4}}}}} is:
If the LCM of two numbers a and b is 60 and their HCF is 15. Determine their mean proportion.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The product of two numbers is equal to the product of their LCM and HCF.

Product = 60 × 15 = 900

Mean proportion of two numbers is the square root of their product.

Mean proportion = √900 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of a and b = 60

HCF of a and b = 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43a908ea2dc7e88b431deb67ade97f86de828182f291f2df087497ee9065b396.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers (a × b) = LCM × HCF

Mean Proportion of a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ a × b = 60 × 15

⇒ a × b = 900

⇒ Mean Proportion = √(a × b)

⇒ Mean Proportion = √900

⇒ Mean Proportion = 30

**∴ The correct answer is 30.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportion

The mean proportion between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Third Proportion

The third proportion of two numbers a and b is a value c such that a : b = b : c, which gives c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportion

The fourth proportion of three numbers a, b, and c is a value d such that a : b = c : d, which gives d = (b × c) ÷ a.

Product Rule of Numbers

For any two positive integers, the product of the numbers is always equal to the product of their HCF and LCM.
